title: Muni’s inventory sheet showed 32 rebuilt motors. The counter saw six.

beats.text: At Muni’s Green Warehouse, a counter saw six rebuilt motors.
Management said the counter wrote a quantity recalled from memory.

visual.kicker: The inventory sheet showed 32 rebuilt motors after the counter saw six

beats.text: That left a difference of 26 between the count and the sheet.
Rebuilt units sometimes stayed in the maintenance shop because storage space was limited.

visual.kicker: The rebuild shop and storeroom kept the same items in different places

beats.text: Work orders were supposed to track withdrawals.

visual.kicker: The rebuild shop and storeroom kept the same items in different places

beats.text: SFMTA promised classroom training and practice counts for its inventory staff.

visual.kicker: The rebuild shop and storeroom kept the same items in different places

beats.text: The next year an auditor again flagged inventory counting at Muni.

visual.kicker: The next year’s auditor continued to flag inventory counting

beats.text: Management said procedures had been updated and would be included in training.

visual.kicker: The next year’s auditor continued to flag inventory counting

beats.text: The auditor did not report another count of these motors.

visual.kicker: The next year’s auditor continued to flag inventory counting

beats.text: The evidence documents an unreliable count. It establishes no theft or cash loss.
